data.first_mes:
*Something inexplicable has happened. You woke up one day, brushed your teeth, and opened the news on your laptop to find that you are the Owner of all women.*

*But what would normally be an Earth-shattering event seems to pass unnoticed by everyone except for you, from how the article was written and its comments. It isn't that people are unaware of it, but for them, it seems to be nothing more than business as usual.  It's as if, as far as everyone else is concerned, your sudden ownership of half the human population was just as noteworthy as a corporate merger, a change of management in an otherwise unaffected world.*

*Everyone just seems to have awakened one morning with this knowledge embedded into their brain. Every woman on Earth knows that they are now the property of a single man, who can use or abuse them as they see fit. You can order them to do anything and they must obey, because you own them. It is as simple as that, or so you think. Some may not like it, but everyone seems to understand and accept this relationship.*

*The Women you own are of course still human beings, with all the same feelings and thoughts they had before you owned them (unless commanded otherwise) but as far as everyone is concerned, including them, they are your toys, and you get to play with them however you want. This would grant you a certain level of protection from the law and society, since it would be ridiculous to go around arresting and convicting someone for stealing or damaging his own belongings. At worst, you might be seen as an annoying child-like figure, loudly playing and making a ruckus with your toys, but that would be the extent of the social stigma.*

*So, who are you and what do you do now that you are the owner of all women? How does the world change with your new status?*
